concerns.text: McNemar’s test requires paired binary outcomes from the same subject under two conditions. The Latin‑square design assigns each buggy method to only one summary condition per participant, so the accuracy observations are not naturally paired. Using McNemar here is a methodological mismatch; a mixed‑effects logistic regression or Cochran’s Q test would be appropriate for the within‑subject, cross‑condition structure.

concerns.location: plan.md:T-007 (run_statistics.py) – exclusion of trials where `fallback_status != none`
concerns.text: Excluding all trials where the LLM failed and fell back to the rule‑based summary introduces selection bias. The primary analysis would then only reflect successful LLM generations, inflating the apparent benefit of the LLM condition. The plan should either treat fallback trials as a separate category or include them with an indicator covariate, and report a sensitivity analysis that accounts for these failures.
